versions.changelog:
YouTube Learning skill v1.0.0 — Initial release:

- Summarizes YouTube videos, extracts key points, and generates structured notes.
- Builds learning paths and creates quizzes based on video content.
- Supports transcript extraction, searching, and export to text/Markdown.
- Organizes videos with collections, tags, watched status, and linking.
- Integrates with note-taking apps (Notion, Obsidian) and calendar tools.
- Pricing tiers: Intro, Pro, and Team.
